thread:
elaine: Quick sync — Acme listing asks for SOC2 + pen test artifacts. Do we accept full reports or only redacted bundles? Who owns redaction and generating presigned uploads? cc @noah @sam @maria
noah: We require SOC2 Type II attestation + a pen test summary. We shouldn't upload raw exploit details. Partner should provide a redacted bundle and signed attestation; security validates redaction.
maria: For HW partners we also need an HSM/firmware attestation if applicable. Partner must sign NDA before we accept raw reports. Our intake prefers presigned S3 links with 7d expiry. Who will generate those?
security-bot: Checklist created: [SOC2_attestation.pdf, PenTest_summary.pdf, Artifact_manifest.csv]. Add owner tags: security:sam, ops:maria, legal:jen.
sam: Security will QA redaction but prefer partner to do initial redaction. We'll need pen scope, CVE list (redacted), remediation plan, and contact for follow-up. No raw PII or customer data.
elaine: Partner contact: peter@acme.io. He says external pen testers won't share raw logs, but can provide executive summary + remediation plan + sanitized logs. What's minimally acceptable?
jen: Legal: we require signed attestation that no customer data is included, plus remediation timelines. Also need proof of encryption-at-rest for any uploaded artifacts and retention policy.
noah: Operational note — use presign with 7d expiry. Example command we use for partner uploads:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/ACME/pen-report.zip --expires-in 604800 --profile marketplace-uploader
```
maria: Marketplace portal constraints: bundles must be zip, <200MB, include manifest.csv. Can we support one-time token + expiring link to limit access?
sam: Yes. Ops infra can enable one-time-token on upload endpoint. Also require a manifest.csv with sha256 hashes. Manifest format: filename,sha256,size (bytes) — e.g., pen-summary.pdf,3a7b...,123456
elaine: I'll coordinate with Peter to get the bundle and NDA. Sam — can security share a redaction template and a sample manifest we can send to the partner?
sam: Uploading template to Drive and inviting folks now: https://drive.google.com/example-template (placeholder). Template includes redaction checklist: remove IPs, remove internal hostnames, mask account ids, strip PII from logs. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Assigned owners: documentation:sam; presign uploads:ops-infra; legal review:jen. Tag created: #marketplace-evidence.
elaine: Sweet. Can we do a 30m call tomorrow 11am PT to finalize scope and NDA handoff? Who can join?
noah: I'll be there. @maria @sam?
maria: Yes.
sam: Can join first 45 mins.
jen: I can do first 15 for legal signoff.
elaine: Thanks — I'll send calendar invite and include the template + presign instructions in the invite thread.
noah: One more ops detail: ensure the presign path uses a folder per partner with tags like partner=acme and evidence_id in metadata so we can auto-ingest.
maria: Noted. I'll loop in ops-infra on the invite.
elaine: Great — marking action items: 1) send template to partner (elaine), 2) presign link + token (ops-infra), 3) legal attestation draft (jen), 4) redaction QA (sam).
security-bot: Action items recorded. Reminder: keep the raw reports offline unless explicit legal + security signoff.
elaine: Thanks all.
